sections.section_title: CACHEAXI command range start address register (CACHEAXI_CMDRSADDRR)
sections.text_helper: Section 12.7.14 "CACHEAXI command range start address register (CACHEAXI_CMDRSADDRR)" in chapter 12 (AXI cache (CACHEAXI)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 344.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x104
Reset value: 0x00000000
Bits 31:6 CMDSTARTADDR[31:6]: start address of range to which the cache maintenance command
specified in CACHEAXI_CR2.CACHECMD field applies
This field must be set before CACHEAXI_CR2.CACHECMD is written.
Bits 5:0 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
